pages.text: $(l)Create Aeronautics$()$(br)Build working airships, planes and cars out of any blocks.$(br2)$(l)Climbable Ropes for Create Aeronautics$()$(br)Climb vertical ropes on your airships with an empty hand.

$(l)Create Aeronautics: Automated Logistics$()$(br)Station networks and automated docking, so airships can run cargo routes.$(br2)$(l)Create Aeronautics: Transmission & Linkage$()$(br)Linkages and transmissions for building more complex vehicles.

$(l)Create: Aeroworks$()$(br)Gyroscopes, control desks, joysticks and other airship controls.$(br2)$(l)Create: Avionics — ComputerCraft for Aeronautics$()$(br)ComputerCraft control for airships: program your own autopilot.
$(l)Create: Radars$()$(br)Radars, tracking and targeting for ships and cannons.$(br2)$(l)Create: Tweaked Controllers$()$(br)Use a gamepad-style controller to steer contraptions.
$(l)Waystones: Sable (Create Aeronautics Addon)$()$(br)A compatibility mod that allows Waystones to work properly within Sable's SubLevel…
$(l)Tip$()$(br2)Press $(l)R$() on any item for its recipe, $(l)U$() for what it is used in.
